'''Ronald Varim''' was a corrupt [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunter Guild's]] top ten most-wanted fugitives, for neglecting his duties and spending Imperial funds for personal gain. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked him down and killed him.
